details.description: Gemini Omni Flash Preview is a multimodal Gemini model that Google released in public preview on June 30, 2026, described in Google's Gemini API changelog as "a high-performance multimodal model designed for high-speed video generation and conversational video editing." Google has since moved this line to general availability as gemini-omni-1.1-flash (released August 27, 2026, with expanded video extension and interpolation features), and per the changelog the gemini-omni-flash-preview endpoint itself is scheduled for deprecation on September 30, 2026.
advantages: Google describes it as a high-performance multimodal model built for high-speed video generation and conversational video editing, per the Gemini API changelog.
disadvantages: Preview release: Google made the successor gemini-omni-1.1-flash generally available on August 27, 2026 and is deprecating the gemini-omni-flash-preview endpoint on September 30, 2026, per the Gemini API changelog.
No longer listed on Google's current Gemini models page, which now shows only the general-availability gemini-omni-1.1-flash in this line.
use_cases: Fast, conversational video generation and editing, per Google's description of the model.

sources.title: Release notes | Gemini API | Google AI for Developers
Gemini models | Gemini API | Google AI for Developers

notes: Google's own description of this model centers on video generation and conversational video editing, but Bud's catalog facts route it as a chat-completions model with audio_input/image_input/text_input/text_output only (no video modality) and a 1,048,576/65,535 token window; I kept the catalog's facts as instructed and flagged the mismatch here rather than restating a different modality. No maker-published accuracy-style (0-100) benchmark was found for this exact preview id, so evaluations is empty. Because the model is being deprecated September 30, 2026, no current dedicated model-card page remains, so website_url is null.
